meta.purpose: Data-driven skill cast scoring for War3Launcher/hooker

sources: skill auras (e.g. anti-mage spell shield is different)
magicResist.note: P6I type1 uses DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE which DotA scripts treat as magical vs hero; type7/8 UNIVERSAL ignore armor+MR unless ethereal converts type7 to magic

singleTarget.hitProb: predict target pos after castPoint + projectile/delay; 0 if miss and not scout/escape
singleTarget.lasthitMana: if farm context: require kills>=2 OR (kills==1 && denyWaiting && mana high) else block

aoe.candidatePoints: grid around cluster + hero feet for self-centered skills + facing samples for directional

formula.damageFormula: base=20*level; agiRatio=agi/str; if agiRatio<0.5: mult=0.25; elif agiRatio>1.5: mult=0.5*level; else mult=0.25+(agiRatio-0.5)*(0.5*level-0.25); dmg=base+mult*agi
formula.stunFormula: strRatio=str/agi; maxStun=0.25+level; if strRatio<0.5: stun=0.25; elif strRatio>1.5: stun=maxStun; else stun=0.25+(strRatio-0.5)*(maxStun-0.25)

formula.echoDamageNote: plus per-unit echo component from tip/JASS

formula.hitLineDecayNote: Closer units intersect more radial lines; expected lines ~ proportional to solid angle coverage around caster
